verdict.rationale: Base44 documents an official MCP server that exposes a user's Base44 account to any MCP-compatible AI assistant. It also documents an App MCP server for published apps (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) and a Docs MCP server, so connecting an external agent is a first-party capability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP servers working, and detail on the exposed tools, setup steps and authentication.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Base44 MCP server exposes your Base44 account to any MCP-compatible AI assistant.
App MCP lets external AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor connect to your published app through its own Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
The Base44 Docs MCP server lets AI assistants like Cursor, Claude Desktop, and VS Code search Base44 documentation directly.
